questions.question: How does your automated system address the issue of proxy attendance compared to traditional roll calls?
expected_points: Traditional roll calls lose class time and allow proxy attendance
System uses automated face recognition without requiring student hardware
Includes a liveness check to prevent printed photos or phone screens

questions.topic: Design choice on model and detection
questions.question: Why did you choose the HOG face detector over the CNN detector for your Raspberry Pi setup?
expected_points: HOG runs in real time on a Raspberry Pi 4 CPU
The CNN detector took more than 3 seconds per frame

questions.question: How are student facial profiles processed and stored during enrollment to protect student data?
expected_points: Embeddings are averaged and saved as a NumPy .npy file
Raw photos are never stored on the device

questions.question: What do your test results indicate about the system's performance across different lighting conditions?
expected_points: Accuracy was highest in normal classroom light at 94.6 percent
Accuracy dropped in backlit conditions near the window and further down in low light
